summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Signs
summary.text: Astrological query topics cross-referenced to codex 12, including pregnancy and fetal sex, success, childlessness, fornication, buying, planetary nodes, and the twelve places. The page also cites Valens on the twelve places and Antiochus on gendered signs, stellar sect, sign mixtures, pathogenic signs, and licentious signs.
